reserveReview.rationale: At Arc block 28500000 (hash 0xbd136b5f714efc6e2c89fd91992a289b5234c0f992ab4ab7572781097c5f41aa; 2026-10-29T15:49:46Z), vault 0x5befab92a5a3d60f578cb51eeb4e4fd50a1e3123 returns asset()=0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000 (USDC), totalAssets()=75147661912822 raw 6-decimal USDC and totalSupply()=75022197361540051918998766 raw 18-decimal shares. USDC.balanceOf(vault)=9969212851175 raw, 13.266165% of totalAssets, and the sole adapter 0x6adc3de83e00c4a74fda9403043828b831d0f5c3 returns parentVault()=vault, marketIdsLength()=1, realAssets()=expectedSupplyAssets(0xc2db905f174e5defcce01d321b09f15f78856a36a21b90cc7e1abbc29225815d)=65178449061647 raw, 86.733835%; idle plus deployed reconciles exactly to totalAssets. The idle slice is USDC cash already held by the vault, so no strategy market has to repay before it is usable and the ERC-4626 redeem/withdraw path settles it from idle assets: its cash-realization horizon is immediate. The deployed slice remains the single cirBTC-secured Morpho lender claim whose cash realization depends on market liquidity, so its liquidityHorizon stays unknown. The retained 2026-10-15 census at block 26080279 (zero idle, 100% deployed, same single market, 86% LLTV, convertToAssets(1e18)=1000785 raw USDC) is historical and superseded by this split. Neither slice is ownership of borrower collateral or of Circle reserve assets.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Arc block 26080279 (2026-10-15T10:44:09Z), all 75080951234671 raw USDC of vault assets are onchain lender claims in one cirBTC/USDC market, with zero idle USDC, borrower shares or posted collateral at the adapter. Whole-book custody is mixed: the local vault/adapter/Morpho claims are onchain, but Circle's whitepaper identifies collateral 0x171a4217b86a807a64eb94757db6849fb4bdbaa0 as cirBTC, issued by Circle International Bermuda Limited and backed by native BTC custodied by Circle National Trust. USDC reserve custody is a separate parent exposure. Circle's statements about cirBTC reserve segregation do not establish legal segregation or bankruptcy remoteness of krUSDC holder claims. Borrowers reuse loaned USDC; this does not prove that the cirBTC custodian may rehypothecate its BTC reserves. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
